_about: Plan 15 r3 step 3: limits, input settings and the word lists of the decomposition proposal (model input,
schema and verification: interpret/decompose_payload.py, decompose_schema.py, decompose_verify.py). Initial values
of plan 15 r3 4.3, to be checked on the development data before the main evaluation. General Korean grammar only:
no case, table, indicator or answer content. Grammar classes that already exist (joiner particles, negated
exclusion endings, sentence-end marks) are read from lexicon.json, not repeated here.
Step 4 (interpret/decompose_settle.py, interpret/condition_fields.py): settle, certainty_failures,
assumption_sources, condition_fields, inferred_frequency.
segments: most segments a question may have (more: input_limit, the rules path; the question is never cut).
requirements: requirement slots r1..rN of the schema. alternatives: readings besides the primary one.
senses_per_mention: most senses (sense_id) one name mention shows the model (the rest stay in the local table and
are flagged). relations: most sense relations sent (the rest are flagged). payload_chars: most characters of the
serialised payload; over it the descriptions are shrunk in the order of shrink_steps, then input_limit.

shrink_steps._about: Descriptions dropped one after another while the payload is over payload_chars: candidate match paths, then every relation (flagged as omitted), then condition attributes (plan 19 stage 5: last, so that the basis axes and polarities stay as long as the payload allows). Raw question, segments, condition IDs and sense IDs are never dropped.

condition_attrs._about: Condition attributes (contract/shapes.py ATTRS_BY_KIND field names) the model sees per condition kind; the period extraction status is a field of its own (extract_status).

senses._about: Order in which the senses of one name mention are shown (and kept under senses_per_mention): by role in this order, then (plan 19 stage 5, interpret/decompose_payload.py build_senses) by more of the question's positive explicit basis or calc conditions carried in the sense's names and fewer conflicting slot values (the rules' condition word list, no list here), then by match path (exact, dictionary, lexical), then by more catalog rows. Names differing only in spacing or a footnote mark are one sense.

_about: indicator_roles: senses that may fill a requirement's indicator. target_only_roles: senses that are targets
only; a name mention all of whose candidates have such a role, by an exact match, is a sure target-only name
(plan 15 r3 6.1: used as an indicator without ground the primary reading fails).
_about_place_roles: Step 3 fix 2: the sense roles each requirement place may take (a sense, or every candidate of a ref
without one, of another role is a role finding, never a silent pass). indicator: indicator_roles; a target sense
matched by a sure_paths path (or a ref without a sense all of whose candidates are such) is the sure target-only
failure of 6.1, any other target, basis or breakdown sense a non-fatal role_ambiguous, unclassified
indicator_role_unclassified. Other places: role_mismatch (non-fatal); unclassified there is role_mismatch too
(kept, never confirmed). The model's own role ambiguity never counts as ground.

relation_condition_kinds._about: Condition kinds a RelationProposal may name (the relation kind comes from the condition, never from the model).

_about: Segment kinds whose words must be used by a requirement, a condition binding, a polarity link, the request
refs, the unused refs or an ambiguity (plan 15 r3 6.1 segment preservation); request, grammar, space and punct
segments need not be. ignorable_words: general filler words that need no use.
_about_confirmed: Step 3 fix 5: word segments the code confirms as request or grammar words when the model puts them in
the request refs or the unattached unused refs (besides ignorable_words and the words of a code-sure 'not
excluded'). Any other word set aside so is kept as unresolved (unused_unresolved), whatever reason the model gave.
Fix round 2 (E): confirmed_words is an INITIAL value, to be tuned on the development calls (wrong accepts and
wrong rejects). A confirmed word (alone, or followed by one remainder particle: '자료를') is set aside only when the
code finds it part of a request phrase: from it rightwards over spaces, grammar segments, ignorable words and
other confirmed words, the next segment is a request segment ('관련 자료를 보여줘'). The same word elsewhere (inside a
compound concept such as '자료 수집', or with no request word after it) stays unresolved.
General Korean only. remainder_particles: what may be left of a segment beside its subquotes without being a
concept of its own (spaces and punctuation always may).

_about: markers: marker classes (contract MarkerKind) of a negation or exclusion. object_particles: particles that
may stand between the object and its marker ('A를 뺀', 'A가 아니라'). closing_particles: particles that end the
phrase before the object ('X에서 A를 뺀'): the object then stands alone. A clear scope (plan 15 r3 6.2): one name
segment, then at most one object particle and spaces, then the marker; before the name nothing, a closing
particle, a sentence-end mark or a request word. Anything else before it (a list mark, a joiner or genitive
particle, a bare word, another name, a condition) leaves the scope unclear.
_about_certain: User decision 10/20 22:10 (P2): when the scope is unclear because the name before the marker (at most one
object particle and spaces between) is the last member of a list (one of certain_before_markers written right
before it), that name is excluded under every reading: the certain part. It must stay on the negative side and
never be required or put on the positive side; only the rest of the list stays an unclear scope.

_about: Exclusion stems that, followed by the lexicon's negated ending and one of its negating stems
(lexicon.json exclusion.negated_ending, negated_by: '제외하지 않고', '빼지 말고'), make a code-sure 'not
excluded' (plan 15 r3 6.2 row 2): such words exclude nothing.
Step 4 (interpret/decompose_settle.py): how an accepted proposal is settled into the existing contract.
phrases: the compat fragment phrase of each requirement place (negative: the negated side of a polarity link).
term_types: catalog candidate types (contract CandidateType) read as other term types in compat terms (types not
listed are kept). name_parts: the name part (select/needs.py name-only sources: indicator, context, target,
lower) of each place a name finding can sit on.
Step 4 (7.2): the certainty failure (contract CertaintyFailure) a verification finding of a kept structure is
recorded as (failed_sources, scoped to the finding's own requirements, fragments and conditions). name_codes:
findings about a name mapping (detail '<code>:<name part>', a name-only source of select/needs.py).
ambiguity_kinds: the failure of a listed ambiguity by its kind. alternative: an alternative reading kept.
structure: a model structure that differs from the rule structure.
_about_plan19: Plan 19 stage 3: basis_merged (two exclusive positive basis conditions applied to one requirement: the
attribution of those conditions to that requirement is open, scoped to it and the two conditions), ratio_operands
and ratio_order_conflict (as relation_incomplete: the requirements of the relation), added_measure (a lexical
sense adding a measurement meaning: a name finding of that ref, inexact_term family).

_about: User decision 10/20 22:10 (step 4 certainty gap): a rule failure source is never copied because the structures
are the same. Each one is re-checked against the adopted reading and classified (fix round 2, C): resolved_by_code
(the code confirms in the new structure that the problem is gone: left out), still_valid (the code confirms the
same problem there: kept) or not_rechecked (no re-check exists for it: kept conservatively, recorded apart from a
confirmed one). checks: the re-check of each failure kind by its rule detail (decompose_settle.py RECHECKS); a kind
or detail not listed is not_rechecked. A model merely choosing one reading never resolves a ground by itself.
leftover_placed: every leftover word lies on segments the reading places with no finding on them. name_used: no
rule unused name is unused by the reading. condition_bound: every condition of the source is bound to concrete
requirements (question or requirements scope) with no finding on it (unresolved binding or a finding: still_valid;
name content: not_rechecked). group_scope_held: every name of the group is placed with a chosen sense, no finding
or listed ambiguity touches the group, and the catalog leaves only the chosen scope (each placed target, basis or
breakdown name is held by a table of exactly the indicators of the group's requirements it is attached to).
pair_relation: the two fragments are the indicators of two requirements that one verified relation condition
joins, with no finding on them (a finding on them: still_valid; else not_rechecked). A kept source is mapped to the
reading's requirement, fragment and condition IDs and its detail is prefixed with detail_prefix; when its scope
cannot be mapped it is kept for the whole question with the scope_unmapped detail. residual: the question-level
row kept when the reading is not certain and names no failed source in any other case than uncertain_only.
uncertain_only (user decision 10/20 22:48, B): the new structure was verified, means what the rules mean, every
rule failure ground was re-checked and resolved, and it has no failure, seed, unresolved requirement or kept
alternative of its own: the only reason it is not certain is 7.2 (the rules were not certain). Then no row is put
into failed_sources (select/needs.py reads a scope-less row as question-wide uncertainty); the reason is recorded
in decomposition.certainty (certain false, reason).

assumption_sources._about: Step 4 (appendix A 2): the source (question, user, catalog, default) of an internal assumption seed by its reason code; reasons not listed: default.

_about: Plan 19 stage 3 (interpret/decompose_verify.py basis_merged): the effect of two different positive basis
conditions applied to one requirement that the rules path holds exclusive (interpret/table.py _exclusive with
the catalog swap pairs; no basis list of its own). non_fatal (user decision 10/21): a finding scoped to that
requirement and the two conditions, the structure kept and never certain. fatal: basis_merged_fatal, a fallback
reason of the primary reading (an alternative is dropped).
Step 4 (7.4): the per-kind check of 'confirmed' (never a table lookup, never a query result). A condition is
confirmed only when its attribution is settled (own, shared or common of a requirement, ambiguous nowhere) and no
failed source names it, and then by kind: checked_kinds pass that check; never_confirmed kinds (calculation,
relation, function, display) are not confirmed by their position. period: the existing resolver
(select/evidence.py resolve_period) resolves it with the reference date. catalog_kinds: a name mention with
catalog candidates lies over the condition.
Step 4 (7.5): the frequency hint from the period units of a requirement. unit_codes: a period unit (a recent
unit, or the sub-unit of an end expression; no sub-unit: the year) as a frequency code. hint_values: the codes a
hint may give (a consistent month or quarter unit only).
